responsibility: Implements statement-specific pieces of Rust AST name resolution that are not handled inline in the header visitor. In this file, extern blocks appearing as statements are processed by first registering their contained extern items at top level and then resolving each extern item’s detailed type information within the surrounding lexical and canonical path context.
same_name_distinction: Contains the only out-of-line statement-resolution implementation here: handling extern blocks that appear as statements by first registering extern items at top level and then resolving them in context. Unlike the matching header, this file is a narrow implementation companion rather than the main home of statement visitor logic.
